configuration.title: WeaveNet for Copilot
configuration.activeProfile.description: Legacy connection order hint retained for migration compatibility.
configuration.activeProfile.deprecation: All connections are now enabled simultaneously. This setting is cleared automatically and no longer controls routing.
configuration.legacyConnectionField.depr: Configure this field inside an item in weavenet-copilot.profiles. The top-level value is used only during upgrade migration.
configuration.profiles.description: All named global Relay connections are enabled simultaneously and their model catalogs are aggregated. Remote relays must use HTTPS; HTTP is allowed only for localhost and IP loopback addresses. Each profile has an extension-managed UUID and one API key stored only in VS Code SecretStorage. Extra header values are regular VS Code settings and must not contain secrets.
configuration.modelOpenAICapabilities.de: Optional per-model OpenAI request capabilities. Leave fields unset unless the Relay documents support; legacy behavior remains the default.
configuration.modelOpenaiApi.description: Request protocol for this fixed model. An explicit "chat" is a safety veto; set "responses" only when the model and Relay support the Responses API.
configuration.openaiApiStrategy.descript: Application-wide OpenAI API strategy. Defaults to chat. Any explicit chat selection, here or on a fixed model, takes priority over Responses. Changing this setting refreshes model catalogs.
configuration.openaiApiStrategy.auto: Honor fixed-model declarations and probe unspecified OpenAI-compatible models for Responses API support.
configuration.openaiApiStrategy.chat: Force Chat Completions for every OpenAI-compatible model and skip all Responses probes. Use as the safest compatibility fallback.
configuration.openaiApiStrategy.response: Force Responses for models not explicitly pinned to chat and skip Responses probes.
configuration.anthropicVersion.descripti: Anthropic protocol version header sent when calling /messages for Claude models.
configuration.openaiPromptCaching.descri: Send a stable prompt_cache_key for GPT models to improve OpenAI-compatible prompt cache routing.
configuration.openaiPromptCacheKey.descr: Optional override for the GPT prompt_cache_key. Leave empty to use a stable key derived from the current workspace.
configuration.claudePromptCaching.automa: Enable Anthropic prompt caching on system, tools, and the latest two user-message cache breakpoints.
configuration.claudePromptCaching.disabl: Do not send cache_control for Claude requests.
configuration.claudePromptCaching.descri: Claude prompt caching mode. Automatic adds safe cache breakpoints to stable prefixes and recent user turns.
configuration.claudePromptCachingTTL.des: Anthropic prompt cache lifetime. 1h may improve long-running agent sessions but can cost more than 5m.
configuration.temperature.description: Optional sampling temperature. For OpenAI-compatible requests, temperature takes precedence when top_p is also set.
configuration.topP.description: Optional nucleus-sampling top_p. OpenAI-compatible requests send it only when temperature is not configured.
configuration.requestTimeoutSeconds.desc: Maximum seconds to wait for relay response headers. GET model discovery is retried once; chat POST requests are never blindly retried.
configuration.streamIdleTimeoutSeconds.d: Maximum seconds to wait between streamed response chunks before treating the stream as incomplete.
configuration.models.description: Legacy fixed model definitions used only by upgrade migration. Configure models in a profile.
configuration.debug.description: Write redacted request summaries and Claude cache usage to the WeaveNet output channel. API keys and prompt text are never logged.
configuration.debugMode.description: Choose minimal token usage logs, redacted metadata diagnostics, or bounded sensitive request dumps.
configuration.debugMode.metadata: Log token usage and privacy-preserving request metadata.
configuration.debugMode.verbose: Also write bounded full request dumps that may contain prompts, tools, and file content.
configuration.experimental.stabilizeTool: Experimental: for DeepSeek Chat only, execute Copilot activate_* helper tools before the upstream request so the model sees a stable tool list. Disabled by default.
configuration.modelNamePrefix.descriptio: Display prefix for models shown in Copilot Chat.
configuration.includeModels.description: Legacy model filters used only by upgrade migration. Configure filters in a profile.
configuration.excludeModels.description: Legacy model filters used only by upgrade migration. Configure filters in a profile.
configuration.maxInputTokens.description: Hard upper limit for input tokens advertised to Copilot. Lower this when an upstream OAuth model accepts less context than its model metadata reports.
configuration.maxOutputTokens.descriptio: Max output token count advertised to Copilot and optionally sent as max_tokens.
configuration.sendMaxTokens.description: Send the output token limit. Legacy models use max_tokens; explicit model capabilities can use max_completion_tokens or omit it.
configuration.supportsToolCalling.descri: Advertise tool calling support for relay models.
configuration.supportsImageInput.descrip: Advertise image input support. Enable only if your relay and target models accept image parts in OpenAI chat completions.
configuration.imageInputModels.descripti: Optional regular expressions that force image input on matching models. Model metadata is detected automatically from sub2api and OpenRouter.
configuration.disabledImageInputModels.d: Regular expressions that disable image input even when public metadata says a model supports it. Empty by default.
configuration.visionProxyEnabled.descrip: Allow text-only WeaveNet models to accept images by asking the explicitly configured installed vision model for a text description. Disabled by default. Image bytes, the vision instruction, and a bounded message layout that may include user and tool-result text are sent to that model provider and may require authorization or incur additional charges; native vision models bypass this proxy.
configuration.visionProxyModel.descripti: Exact installed native vision model to use, in vendor/id form (for example copilot/gpt-4o). No automatic fallback is used. Do not select a text-only WeaveNet proxy model.
configuration.visionProxyModel.markdownD: Exact installed native vision model to use, in `vendor/id` form (for example `copilot/gpt-4o`). No automatic fallback is used. Do not select a text-only WeaveNet proxy model. Run [WeaveNet: Pick Vision Proxy Model](command:weavenet-copilot.pickVisionProxyModel) to choose from your installed models instead of typing the ID by hand.
configuration.visionProxyPrompt.descript: Optional instruction sent with image bytes and surrounding message context to the configured vision model. Leave empty for WeaveNet's factual description and OCR prompt. Descriptions are reused briefly from a bounded in-memory cache across Agent tool turns; they are never persisted, and an expired historical image is not automatically reprocessed.
configuration.metadataRefreshHours.descr: How often to refresh cached OpenRouter model metadata, in hours.
configuration.requestHeaders.description: Legacy headers used only by upgrade migration. Values are regular VS Code settings, not SecretStorage. Do not put secrets here.
